tools.name: klipfolio_get_profile
tools.description: Get the user and company that own the API key. Add full=true for tab instances, groups and permissions. Klipfolio API: GET /profile.

tools.name: klipfolio_list_klips
tools.description: List Klips (the charts and tables on dashboards) the user can access. Filter by data source or client. Klipfolio API: GET /klips.

tools.name: klipfolio_get_klip
tools.description: Get one Klip by id. Add full=true to include share rights. Klipfolio API: GET /klips/{id}.

tools.name: klipfolio_list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards (the API calls them tabs). Klipfolio API: GET /tabs.

tools.name: klipfolio_get_dashboard
tools.description: Get one dashboard (tab) by id. Add full=true for the Klip instances and share rights. Klipfolio API: GET /tabs/{id}.

tools.name: klipfolio_list_datasources
tools.description: List data sources with refresh interval, last refresh time and whether the source is dynamic. Klipfolio API: GET /datasources.

tools.name: klipfolio_get_datasource
tools.description: Get one data source: connector, format, refresh interval, disabled state and dates. Klipfolio API: GET /datasources/{id}.

tools.name: klipfolio_list_datasource_instances
tools.description: List data source instances with refresh failure count, data size and last refresh time. Use it to find stale or failing data. Klipfolio API: GET /datasource-instances.

tools.name: klipfolio_get_datasource_instance
tools.description: Get one data source instance by id. Klipfolio API: GET /datasource-instances/{id}.

tools.name: klipfolio_get_datasource_instance_data
tools.description: Get the stored data of a data source instance (CSV or JSON text, as the source holds it). The reply can be large. Klipfolio API: GET /datasource-instances/{id}/data.

tools.name: klipfolio_list_users
tools.description: List users of the company. Search by email or external id, and add roles or groups. Klipfolio API: GET /users.

tools.name: klipfolio_list_groups
tools.description: List user groups of the company. Klipfolio API: GET /groups.

tools.name: klipfolio_refresh_datasource_instance
tools.description: WRITE: queue a refresh of one data source instance so its Klips get new data. The refresh replaces the stored data and runs later, not at once. A repeat call queues another refresh. It uses the vendor's own refresh quota. Klipfolio API: POST /datasource-instances/{id}/@/refresh.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: klipfolio_list_users, klipfolio_refresh_datasource_instance · Private data: klipfolio_get_profile · Public sink: klipfolio_get_klip, klipfolio_get_dashboard, klipfolio_list_users, klipfolio_refresh_datasource_instance · Destructive: klipfolio_get_datasource.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: klipfolio_list_users, klipfolio_refresh_datasource_instance · Private data: klipfolio_get_profile · Public sink: klipfolio_get_klip, klipfolio_get_dashboard, klipfolio_list_users, klipfolio_refresh_datasource_instance · Destructive: klipfolio_get_datasource

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
